note: vespera_core: MediaType, Encoding and Operation refuse a Reference Object like the other inline-only types (a $ref in content or in an operation no longer loads as an empty value). Multipart errors also escape bidi overrides, isolates, zero-width marks and line/paragraph separators in echoed part names. The DIRECT overflow stash (DirectStash.dispatchResumable0) refuses an out buffer below 1 KiB like dispatchDirect0, so an error wire can no longer overflow without a handle. The bench-only request-builder twin in vespera_inprocess honours default_json_content_type like the production path.
